caseName: Broadcast Music, Inc. v. Columbia Broadcasting System, Inc.
caseNameFull: Broadcast Music, Inc. v. Columbia Broadcasting System, Inc. and American Society of Composers, Authors & Publishers v. Columbia Broadcasting System, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. The Solicitor General is invited to file a brief in these cases expressing the views of the United States. Reported below: 562 F. 2d 130.
